strategy.primary: Sacrifice aristocrats: edicts and forced sacrifices (Fleshbag, Plaguecrafter, Vona's Hunger, Flare of Malice, Call to the Grave, Grave Pact, Dictate of Erebos) shrink opposing boards while every sacrifice grows Thraximundar, and Cultist / Shizo make him an evasive commander-damage clock.
strategy.secondary: Gravecrawler / Reassembling Skeleton loops with Phyrexian or Ashnod's Altar, Pitiless Plunderer, Rooftop Storm and drain payoffs (Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat) for deterministic kills.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Thraximundar
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Haste
Whenever Thraximundar attacks, defending player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
Whenever a player sacrifices a creature, you may put a +1/+1 counter on Thraximundar.

identity.why: Attack edict and growth from every sacrifice.
